title: A Bioinspired Soft Manipulator Based on Wave Spring Structure: Design and Control.
authors: Sui, Dongbao; Zhang, Zongwei; Wang, Tianshuo; Zhao, Sikai; Zhang, Yu; Wang, Xinzui
one_liner_zh: 该文研究基于波簧结构的仿生软体机械臂设计与控制，属于机器人工程领域，不涉及蛋白质结构计算或相关AI/物理模拟方法。
abstract: Architectured soft structures have unlocked new possibilities for designing continuum manipulators with tailored mechanical performance. This work introduces a bioinspired soft manipulator based on modular wave spring units, leveraging the high elasticity of wave spring structures to enable compliant deformation and axial extensibility of the soft manipulator. To achieve precise control of the soft manipulator, a neural network-based inverse kinematics framework is developed to establish an efficient mapping from desired end poses to tendon actuation lengths. An iterative learning control strategy is further integrated to compensate for material hysteresis, friction, and external disturbances. A prototype is fabricated using flexible 3D-printable material (TPU), and comprehensive experiments are conducted to validate extensible performance, point positioning accuracy, trajectory-tracking accuracy, and compliant interaction capability. The results demonstrate that the proposed wave spring-based soft manipulator achieves a high extension ratio and reliable control precision.
abstract_zh: 架构化软体结构为设计具有定制机械性能的连续型机械臂开辟了新的可能性。本工作介绍了一种基于模块化波形弹簧单元的仿生软体机械臂，利用波形弹簧结构的高弹性实现软体机械臂的柔顺变形和轴向伸展性。为实现对软体机械臂的精确控制，开发了一种基于神经网络的逆运动学框架，以建立从期望末端位姿到肌腱驱动长度的有效映射。进一步集成迭代学习控制策略，以补偿材料迟滞、摩擦和外部扰动。使用柔性3D打印材料（TPU）制造了原型，并进行了综合实验，以验证伸展性能、点定位精度、轨迹跟踪精度和柔顺交互能力。结果表明，所提出的基于波形弹簧的软体机械臂实现了高伸展比和可靠的控制精度。
